name: Rizuhble's Happy Little Splats
rows: Getting bursted in lane. Sell it once you're out of slots.
Get after Grit if needed. Ahead? Skip it until you're dying. Sell Spirit Shielding for it.
Spirit damage that keeps hurting you after the hit: Infernus, Seven, Vyper, Lady Geist.
Most of their damage is gun.
Lash ult, Infernus ult. Anything big you can see coming.
Knockdown, Slowing Hex, Disarming Hex and slows.
Flyers like Vindicta and Grey Talon keep getting away.
Living Ink hits shorten your ult too, so it comes up often. Sell Enchanter's Emblem for this.
If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
changes: Round 13: new full spirit build (the existing one is the gun hybrid) — style source: lockbuilds official 'MAX SPIRIT VIOLET' (Oct 18: Extra Regen, Extra Spirit, Mystic Regen, Mystic Burst, Extra Charge, Rapid Recharge, Spirit Shielding, Radiant, Healing Booster; core Improved Spirit, Tankbuster, Superior Cooldown, Boundless, Escalating Exposure; optional Enchanter's; late Spirit Burn, Infuser, Transcendent Cooldown), plus Kieran's Surge of Power on her 1. Compress Cooldown, Mystic Vulnerability and Spirit Lifesteal are the components of that build's Superior Cooldown, Escalating Exposure and Infuser. Living Ink has 2 charges, so Extra Charge/Rapid Recharge work. Mystic Burst bought after Surge of Power (ink 35 + 0.7x at ~49 + 28 imbued ≈ 89 > 80); Tankbuster at 22.4k: ink T3 35 + 1.1x(100 + 28) ≈ 176 > 165. No hero-wide pick rates used. Order: mobalytics build-stats most likely path 3124313311422442 (that site's Violet data is mostly spirit: its top items are Extra Charge, Rapid Recharge, Improved Spirit), Still Life maxed first; lockbuilds says her main damage is 3 and 1.

Round 14: spirit no longer overshoots: Mystic Burst and Radiant Regeneration moved after the health spike (was spirit 8k at 8.8k souls with 800 health; now spirit 4.8k at 5.6k, health 4.8k at 9.6k, then spirit). Mystic Burst still clears 80 at its new buy point. Mystic Reverb sold Mystic Vulnerability, which has already turned into Escalating Exposure by then: now sells Healing Booster. Counters sold Mystic Vulnerability too (it becomes Escalating Exposure): now Spirit Shielding. Witchmail added to rich as the pricier Enchanter's Emblem so that T2 has a named sell; Divine Barrier added as Dispel Magic's pricier version.

Round 15: Counters desc was 121 characters (game limit 112): now 'Get after Grit' (6.4k, the first green after the spirit spike; counters are green items themselves). Knockdown note no longer claims she 'can't sketch' flyers.
Round 17: Divine Barrier note 'If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.' (Dispel is in Counters; one wording across builds).
Round 20: late list Mystic Reverb, Witchmail, Spiritual Overflow, Refresher; core+late 75.2k.

Round 23: Witchmail out of the late list (its cooldown cuts overlap Living Ink, which already cuts every cooldown per hero hit), Diviner's Kevlar in at #2 (1000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s on each Abstract Landscape, which Ink hits bring back sooner; second health step for a low-health build). Witchmail also sold Spirit Shielding, which Counters already sell; Overflow now sells Tankbuster.
Round 25: ability order 3124313311422442 -> 1132341312244324 (worked out from the kit for this build's playstyle).
